description: This file implements the SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformService using JPA repository and contains methods for submitting, modifying, approving, rejecting, and deleting savings account applications, including GSIM (Group Savings Individual Monitoring) operations. It handles data validation, persistence, business events, and transaction management within the savings account application workflow.

classes.name: SavingsApplicationProcessWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implements core savings account application workflows including submission, modification, approval, rejection, deletion, and GSIM-specific operations, managing transactions, data validation, persistence, and event notification in a banking context.

methods.name: submitGSIMApplication
methods.description: Handles bulk submission of GSIM (Group Savings Individual Monitoring) savings account applications from a JSON array, processing each application within a synchronized block.

methods.name: submitApplication
methods.description: Creates a new savings account application, supports GSIM, auto-generates account numbers, validates data, persists the account, and triggers business events.

methods.name: modifyGSIMApplication
methods.description: Modifies a parent GSIM savings application and all associated child applications.

methods.name: modifyApplication
methods.description: Updates existing savings account application details, including client, group, product, charges, and other attributes, with validation and persistence.

methods.name: deleteApplication
methods.description: Deletes a savings application if it is in a specific state, along with associated notes, after validation.

methods.name: approveGSIMApplication
methods.description: Approves a parent GSIM savings application and all its child applications, updating savings statuses accordingly.

methods.name: approveApplication
methods.description: Handles the approval process of a savings application, updating status, saving notes, and triggering post-approval events.

methods.name: undoGSIMApplicationApproval
methods.description: Reverses the approval of a GSIM parent application and all child applications, resetting statuses.

methods.name: undoApplicationApproval
methods.description: Undoes the approval of a specific savings application, restoring previous state, and optionally adding notes.

methods.name: rejectGSIMApplication
methods.description: Rejects a parent GSIM application and its child applications, updating status accordingly.

methods.name: rejectApplication
methods.description: Processes rejection of a savings application with status update, notes, and event notification.

methods.name: applicantWithdrawsFromApplication
methods.description: Handles the withdrawal of an applicant from an application, updating status and adding notes.

methods.name: createActiveApplication
methods.description: Creates and activates a new savings account application with validation, saving, and journal postings.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles database integrity errors, mapping specific exceptions to user-friendly messages.

methods.name: generateAccountNumber
methods.description: Auto-generates an account number for savings accounts requiring it, updating the account entity.

methods.name: checkClientOrGroupActive
methods.description: Ensures the associated client or group is active before proceeding with operations.
